title: Ryan Mulligan: a strip of little interactive CSS toys on top, plain text below
note: A front-end dev's homepage. Across the top, a sideways-scrolling strip of small live demos (a skateboard, a blinking heart, a gnome, a weather card), each a real CSS/JS experiment, with an 'Unskew' and 'Disable preview' checkbox under it. Below that the page is plain and readable: a short bio, 'Most recent articles', 'The bit about myself' and 'Some personal joy' headings in a condensed display face. Worth reusing: put the playful things in one clearly bounded strip so the rest of the site can be calm.
